dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: What should we do now? We are running out of coins to survive the week and quests have run out.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: Maybe we should go check at the guild again. They should've gotten new quests by now.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: I sure hope so. All the remaining quests are just fetching quest which isn't that helpful to our finicial status.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: Stop being so negative Alann. Things will work out in the end. Now let's go check the guild.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: A special quest specifically for us? That is really rare.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: Told you, everything work out well at the end innit.

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: But look at the seal, it is a black seal which means this is no ordinary request. We should find a secure place to read the letter.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: As per this request, we need you to save the princess of the near by kingdom, Faee. We got info from the spy that they are planning to throw a coup after the festival. So please make sure the rescue the princecss in time. If you accept the quest, we will give you a bag of gold coins and if you have successfully handover the princess to us there will be five more bags.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: F... FIVE BAGS OF GOLD COINS?

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: We can survive 2 winters with that amount of coins.

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: That's if we successfully delivered the princess to them.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: High-risk High-reward as they say. So Alann, do we acccept the quest.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: Well there is nothing to do for us anyway so and it had been a while since the last request so yeah let's do this.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: Everyone ready for this once in a lifetime quest?

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: Well I am pretty nervouce since this is our first time doing a quest like this. Usually are just slaying monsters and solving dramas.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: Well we could expect this kind of quest in the future once we've successfully rescued the princess.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: Easier said than done

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: Everyone is packed right? Then let's hit the road. Remember the faster we reach to Faee the better it is for us. We have to plan routes beforehand.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: Yeah we could talk along the way. It will take a few days to get there.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: I guess this is where I sing a song before we leave to boost out morale- Everyone don't leave me behind.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: I wonder if the person behind the letter can be trusted..

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: It is a litle bit too late to think about that we are halfway to Faee.

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: And we have already spend quarter of the bag to get new resources for everything.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: Well yeah. But we should be worry about what kind of the person is behind the letter before we hand over the princes.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: I do agree. But we should be worried about how we are gonna leave the town without getting caught by the guards that will be after us like a swarm of angry bee.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: We should have enough time to plan a escape route if we made to Faee in a few days. We should rush before the darkness reigns over the forest.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: It's gonna be harsh on our horses.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: Less speaking start moving.

dialogue.speaker: Horse
dialogue.text: <Finally we have arrived Faee, I can now rest until those finish their jobs.>

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: I'll go check the city for secure paths first later tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: Appreciated it. Ed, Za'el and I will be planning how we move at the night of festival.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: I am going to hit the tavern tonight for sure. The trip is tiresome without a proper rest the whole road.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: Well we could rest a bit for today since we still got 6 nights until the start of the festival.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: Just don't overdo it you two. Remember we aren't here for a vacation.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: I bet Jiiva would enjoy this festival. Especially the last night.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: It seems pretty much the same to me.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: You two focus on out mission. We weren't here to relax. Tonight is the most important night of our journey.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: You know if you're too much cautious and stiff all the time, the guards might think that your are up to something so just relax until we find the pricess and Jiiva give us the signal.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: I'm bac- God Damn the entire room reeks of ale. Were you drinking the entire night Za'el?

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: Sorry, the ale deal was so good so I bought the entire barrel and ended up finished it in one go.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: You better clean the room after taking a bath. God, I better open all the windows to let fresh air replace the smell.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: <Burps> My bad G.

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: Hmmmm...

dialogue.speaker: Merchant
dialogue.text: Well is there anything you like? Better be quick or others will buy ya marked thing.

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: (I only have enough coins for one Spinosarus figure. Which one should I grab...)

dialogue.speaker: Event
dialogue.text: A few moments later

dialogue.speaker: Merchant
dialogue.text: Sir? you have been standing still for 30 minutes straight.

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: (Maybe I'll grab both with the coins that Ed gave me for tonight's groceries

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: Well sir I'll get both figures of Spinosarus-

dialogue.speaker: Merchant
dialogue.text: Boy they all sold out 15 minutes ago.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: I wonder if he will like those flowers.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: Is it for me?

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: Yeah...

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: N-No!! What are you doing here Ed. Aren't you supposed to be performing right now at an event in townsquare?

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: Oh that, I've done my part so I decided to wander around the city and I saw you entering the garden.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: Next time don't tease me like that.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: These fruits seem fresh.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: But the prices though, they are a bit more expensive than the usual ones.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: Maybe because they are from another kingdo-

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: Ed we don't have enough time for a performance we got places to be remember.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: But this will be quic-

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: No but. Come on get moving.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: No don't you dare Ed.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: Dude I am not even doing anything at all. Why do you hate me so much.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: I know you're gonna sneak into the castle and perform in front of the princess again!

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: Well. . . .

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: We going back now.

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: Well there goes another team from our Guild to hunt a Spinosaraus...

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: Why didn't you go with them, we all know that you want to go to that Jurassic Land.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: Let him be Ed-

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: Nuh uh, he has been whining since the guild discovered a way to reach that island.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: You two stop the non-sense argument and pick a quest instead. We are running low on coins for this week.

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: Can you do dinosaurs related quest? I want to see them.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: Let's see my quest is to slay a giant Hermit Crab near this lak-

dialogue.speaker: Fisherman
dialogue.text: Nice day for fishing innit hu ha.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: Eh.. Yeah it sure is a great day.

dialogue.speaker: Fisherman
dialogue.text: Nice day for fishing innit hu ha.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: Yeah yeah I heard it the first time loud and clear.

dialogue.speaker: Fisherman
dialogue.text: Nice day for fishing innit hu ha.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: Are you.. Can you even speak anything at all aside from that?

dialogue.speaker: Fisherman
dialogue.text: Nice day for fishing innit hu ha.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: (God he's stuck with one dialogue)

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: Why is this path quiet. It is usually busy with all travellers and animals.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: Yeah it sure is a bit weird.

dialogue.speaker: MysteriousPerson
dialogue.text: 止まりなさい皆の者.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: What language is that? Any idea Jiiva?

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: Sorry never heard of that language befrore. This is my first time.

dialogue.speaker: MysteriousPerson
dialogue.text: この先に大熊は 暴れているので 他の道を使んでください.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: Is he trying to warn us? or mug us?

dialogue.speaker: MysteriousPerson
dialogue.text: あいつは十人の命をもう奪った だからハンタータクト様が片付けてる途中に こちに来ないでください.

dialogue.speaker: Alann
dialogue.text: I think we should just quickly run past him.

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: Yeah I support that. This conversation isn't making any progress so we should just move forward.

dialogue.speaker: MysteriousPerson
dialogue.text: 皆の物 あっちはダメです こちに戻りなさい-

dialogue.speaker: Event
dialogue.text: A few minutes later

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: I think we've lost that person. It should be fine to stop running.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: Coming out of nowhere and started speaking in a language no one understands. Although I wonder that is he trying to say.

dialogue.speaker: Jiiva
dialogue.text: Maybe he is trying to tell us that there is a monster up ahead? If it is true we're done for. We didn't bring any of our battle equipments.

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: Ah

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: Ed, don't look back and walk slowly towards us.

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: Why are you guys looking like that. Is there a giant bear behind me? Stop joking around keep on moving come on.

dialogue.speaker: Kuma
dialogue.text: <ゴホッ>

dialogue.speaker: Ed
dialogue.text: SO IT WAS A WARNING.

dialogue.speaker: Horne
dialogue.text: zzz

dialogue.speaker: Za'el
dialogue.text: What is that. I've never heard of horses sleeping like this.
